decisions.reason: The compact rotating-skip dumper extends the firm's core construction equipment line, was only launched in 2023, and uses existing production and service capabilities.
The articulated dumper builds on established know-how and is newly launched, so a mid-sized machinery maker would give it time in a growing industry.

The mine rescue vehicle is farther from the core offer and serves a niche market, but it fits the firm's underground expertise and needs a longer sales cycle, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
The compact telescopic loader complements the firm's lifting and construction range and is a fresh launch with its own web page, so it is likely to be kept.
